summary: Green Salt Lake Landscaping (www.gslscape.com) presents as technically mature - Digital Maturity 89/100 Advanced with Lighthouse SEO 100/100 and Performance 89/100 and 0 broken links of 34 checked. Deterministic assessment Opportunity Score is 38/100 (95% confidence, source Multi-page website audit + Lighthouse) with main issue 'Website clarity' - homepage passed lightweight checks. With 7879 words on homepage, inconsistent H1s, and accessibility flags, the remaining opportunities are refinement rather than rebuild, focused on conversion path, heading structure, and accessibility polish.

topOpportunities.title: Homepage lacks inline conversion - quote capture lives only on /quote
topOpportunities.evidence: Homepage has forms: 0 and inputCount: 0 while /quote has forms: 2 and inputCount: 12 - homepage CTA phrases detected: 21 but no inline capture; Business Intelligence Online customer action points 0/10 with evidence 'No booking or online-estimate signal'
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Visitors see 21 CTA phrases but homepage itself has 0 forms. If primary intent is 'Free Estimates' from title 'Landscaping Salt Lake City UT | Free Estimates', requiring a page jump adds friction to an otherwise qualified visitor.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Make the estimate action capturable from homepage without leaving the page - add a short inline form or sticky CTA that links directly to https://www.gslscape.com/quote which already has 2 forms.

topOpportunities.title: Missing H1s and heading order on core pages
topOpportunities.evidence: Crawled pages show h1Count 0 on /services (4124 words), /gallery (4207 words), /reviews (4550 words), /quote (3897 words), /contact (3805 words) vs h1Count 1 on / and service subpages; Lighthouse failure: 'Heading elements are not in a sequentially-descending order'
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Search readiness is Lighthouse 100/100 and Structured data: found, but empty H1s on 5 of 10 crawled pages weakens topical clarity for both SEO and accessibility tools that rely on heading hierarchy.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Add a single descriptive H1 to each zero-H1 page (/services, /gallery, /reviews, /quote, /contact) and verify H2/H3 sequence matches the Lighthouse heading-order audit.

topOpportunities.title: Accessibility polish - contrast and label mismatches
topOpportunities.evidence: Lighthouse failures include: 'Background and foreground colors do not have a sufficient contrast ratio' and 'Elements with visible text labels do not have matching accessible names' and Accessibility score 91/100
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Accessibility 91/100 is Good but these two failures can reduce readability and screen-reader accuracy for conversion elements, especially on mobile where Lighthouse was tested.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Fix the specific color-contrast and label-content-name-mismatch instances flagged in Lighthouse - typically CTA buttons and navigation links given 21 CTA phrases detected.

topOpportunities.title: Incremental performance tuning despite Good mobile quality
topOpportunities.evidence: Lighthouse metric Speed Index 4562ms and Total size was 3,370 KiB with flags: 'Est savings of 346 KiB' for image delivery, 'Est savings of 521 KiB' for cache lifetimes, 'Est savings of 51 KiB' for unused JavaScript
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Performance 89/100 and MobileQuality 'Good' with LCP 2.9s is solid for a landscaper site; these are incremental gains to keep Speed Index under 4.6s as gallery images (7 images on homepage) grow.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Prioritize the Lighthouse savings already quantified - compress/deliver responsive images (346 KiB), extend cache lifetimes (521 KiB), and defer unused JavaScript (51 KiB) - retest LCP currently 2900ms.
